name: Flexdeal, SIMFE, S.A.
note: Portuguese listed investment company (Euronext Lisbon, ticker FLEXD), seated in Barcelos, run by Alberto Jorge Silva Amaral. Held 49.21% of the share capital and voting rights of Raize - Instituição de Pagamentos in January 2026 (Jornal Económico, 20 Jan 2026) and informed the Bank of Portugal of an intention to raise that stake to up to 51%.
